name: Colorfest Electric Night Run 2026
short_description: Colorfest Electric Night Run 2026 is a half-marathon event on August 1, 2026 at SM Mall of Asia, Pasay, Philippines, organized by HyveSports.
ai_summary: Colorfest Electric Night Run 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for August 1, 2026, at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, Philippines. Organized by HyveSports, the race offers four distance options: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km, allowing participants of varying fitness levels to take part. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km, 3km) suit different runner levels
Convenient, accessible venue at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay
Organized by an established organizer, HyveSports
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are unavailable
research_highlights: The 2026 edition takes place August 1, 2026 at SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay, with a night-wave gun start and distance options of 3K, 5K, and 10K (15K and 21K categories were already sold out per the official registration page).

The race is organized around a color-run/night-party format: previous editions (e.g., the August 2024 'Recharged' edition) featured color zones and an after-party with a live DJ set following the run.
Official registration terms state pricing tiers (Early Bird, Regular, Late Chance) and note that the event is strictly no-refunds.
In a prior 'final wave' of registration for the 2026 run, organizers noted that finisher medals for that wave would be delivered after race day rather than given on-site.

faqs.question: When is the Colorfest Electric Night Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The Colorfest Electric Night Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 1, 2026. This date has been set by the organizer, HyveSports, for the event held in Pasay, Philippines, at the SM Mall of Asia venue.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The race offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km run, a 5km run, and a shorter 3km option, catering to a range of runner experience levels and fitness goals.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Colorfest Electric Night Run 2026?
faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for the Colorfest Electric Night Run 2026 has not yet been announced. Interested participants will need to wait for further updates from the organizer, HyveSports, regarding sign-up details and availability.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The Colorfest Electric Night Run 2026 takes place at SM Mall of Asia, located in Pasay, Philippines. This venue serves as the starting point for all four distance categories offered during the event, organized by HyveSports.
